title: Compositional Unalignment: Auditing Safety in Large Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.07216v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) are vulnerable to compositional harm: an image and a prompt that are benign in isolation become harmful through the model's cross-modal reasoning. Recent alignment methods report strong scores on compositional safety benchmarks, but an LLM judge only measures observed behavior and cannot reveal how robustly safety is integrated into the model. We argue that un-alignment provides a complementary audit of alignment robustness. We first show that minimal supervised fine-tuning reaches an LLM-judge score comparable to a multi-stage reinforcement-learning pipeline, so similar benchmark scores cannot establish robustness by themselves. We then show that recognition and refusal of compositional harm are decoupled: nine standard direction-finding methods detect compositional harm with up to AUC=0.99, yet ablating the recovered directions either leaves refusal intact or destroys model coherence. translated_title: 组合式去对齐：审计大型视觉-语言模型的安全性
translated_abstract: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）容易受到组合性伤害：一张图像和一个提示词各自单独来看都是无害的，但经过模型的跨模态推理后却可能变得有害。近期的对齐方法在组合安全基准上报告了很高的分数，但LLM裁判只能测量观察到的行为，无法揭示安全性在模型内部被整合得有多稳健。我们认为，“去对齐”为对齐稳健性提供了一种互补的审计手段。我们首先表明，极少量的监督微调即可达到与多阶段强化学习流水线相当的LLM裁判分数，因此仅凭相似的基准分数本身无法确立稳健性。随后我们表明，对组合性伤害的识别与拒绝是相互解耦的：九种标准的方向探测方法能够以最高AUC=0.99检测出组合性伤害，然而消融所恢复出的方向，要么使拒绝行为保持完好，要么破坏模型的连贯性。因此我们……
tldr: 本文提出以“去对齐”作为安全对齐的审计手段，揭示大型视觉-语言模型的对齐并不稳健——极少量的监督微调即可达到与多阶段强化学习流程相当的基准分数，且模型对组合性伤害的识别与拒绝能力是相互解耦的。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes un-alignment as a complementary audit of alignment robustness, showing that safety alignment in large vision-language models is not robust—minimal supervised fine-tuning matches multi-stage RL pipeline benchmark scores, and recognition of compositional harm is decoupled from refusal.
